description: utopia-php/openapi: OpenAPI 2.0, 3.0 and 3.1 documents (JSON or decoded arrays) read into one version-independent model; local $ref resolution, schema dialects, annotated string enums.

openapi.parse.doc: Parser::parse(input, version?) (or (new Parser())->read with via: read) of {text} | {fixture} | {document}, dumped

openapi.resolve_schema.doc: $spec->resolveSchema(schema at `at`): the name of the identical schema in $spec->schemas (or null), whether it is the input itself, and its dump

composite.new.doc: new CompositeSchema(composition, schemas read under 3.1, not, discriminator, annotations..., location), dumped

resolver.resolve.doc: (new LocalResolver(document))->resolve(new Reference(reference), new ResolutionContext(trail ?? [], baseUri ?? null))

operation.security_names.doc: accepted/requiredSecuritySchemeNames() of an Operation with these security alternatives

quirks.description: Lists of names (tags, required, consumes, produces, schemes, server variable enums, security scopes) are cast item by item with strval()/(string): a nested array becomes "Array" (with a warning), true "1", null "", a float its precision-14 form (1e25 is "1.0E+25"), instead of being refused. Rust casts the same way.
quirks.case: edge.json#scalar lists are cast with (string): arrays become Array (quirk)

quirks.description: A schema's enum list and its discriminator are checked against the literal locations 'schema/enum' and 'schema/discriminator', so their errors do not name where the schema is (every other schema error does).
quirks.case: edge.json#enum errors name schema/enum, not the location (quirk)

quirks.description: Under 3.1 a type list keeps every item that is not the string 'null'; a JSON null item is kept and then read as no type, so `type: [null]` is an any schema that is not nullable.

deviations.php: Given a decoded document (an array) whose strings are not valid UTF-8, or that holds objects of classes other than stdClass, PHP keeps the bytes in names, descriptions and references, and treats foreign objects like stdClass (or fails to cast them).
deviations.reason: The Rust model holds text as String: a decoded document's non-UTF-8 text is converted lossily (U+FFFD), and php_std::Value has no foreign objects. JSON input, the library's own decoding path, is always valid UTF-8 (json_decode refuses anything else), so this only concerns hand-built arrays; free-form values (default, example, enum, extensions) keep their bytes exactly.
